answer: Locks are recorded in glacier, expire in yarrow, and cipher lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 180 aliases therefore needs 186 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1735 identities would post 3145 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
